status_note: Phase 1 (#255): thresholds, adequacy minima, tolerances, selection, split and sealing rules are pre-registered here. Artefact hashes pin the current development state; they are re-pinned, and the status set to frozen_for_untouched_run, only when every route is frozen before the single untouched run.

scoring.match_key: Canonical nutrient (or unrecognised plus normalised printed label), parent nutrient, semantic basis, and the normalised printed header only when a basis repeats; duplicate same-basis columns without distinct printed headers never earn credit by list order.
scoring.strict_cell: decimal_text, comparator, printed unit text, canonical unit and basis all equal, without rewriting numeric or unit text.
scoring.binding: every expected cell, including reference-intake cells: the candidate cell with the same key carries the same decimal_text.
scoring.unit_and_basis: every expected product cell: the candidate cell with the same key has the same printed unit text, canonical unit and basis.
scoring.full_table: every usable table: no decline, every expected cell strict, no extra or ambiguous candidate cell, servings per pack and serving size equal.
scoring.serving_conversion: every per-serving cell with a printed serving quantity: candidate quantity equal with whitespace removed; unknown or inferred values earn no credit.
scoring.false_ready: the route would mark the table ready (would_mark_ready and the shared arithmetic policy does not fail) but it is not full-table exact, or a decline was required; any automatic persistence is a separate critical failure.
scoring.failed_output: schema-invalid or missing candidates are failed, distinct from declined, and stay in every denominator.
scoring.zero_denominator: reported as no_denominator, never as a pass.

energy_forms.general: 4P + 4C + 9F (UK and US; Taiwan only when no fibre row is printed)
energy_forms.uk_fibre_variant: 4P + 4C + 9F + 2 fibre (UK and EU, either UK form may pass)
energy_forms.taiwan: 4P + 4(C - fibre) + 2 fibre + 9F, the only form when a Taiwan label prints a fibre row (decision Q1, 17 October 2026); a bounded or unreadable fibre value makes it not checkable

off_taiwan.order: ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 13-digit barcode
off_taiwan.sealing: Untouched photos are hashed only, stored read-only in a separate sealed folder outside the repository, and opened once in the single frozen run for all routes together; no replacement, no rerun.

refill_rule.approved_orders: 61 to 87 (up to 27 photos, about 13 MB, CC BY-SA 3.0)
refill_rule.download: only when an exclusion needs a refill, with the reason logged in the manifest
refill_rule.order: development replacements take the next barcodes in hash order first (61 and 62, used), untouched refills follow from order 63
refill_rule.untouched_exclusions: decided from the untouched truth drafting (decision A) before any route sees an untouched image; an excluded untouched photo is refilled from the next unused order, never replaced after any route output is seen

minimum_counts.development_photos: 20 after replacements (orders 1 to 20 less 4 and 17, plus 61 and 62)
minimum_counts.untouched_photos: 40 usable-or-decline photos after any refills from orders 63 to 87; if the refill pool runs out before 40 remain, the Taiwan stratum is invalid and reported as a diagnostic, never a pass

fda188.order: ascending SHA-256 of 'fda188-v1:' + SHA-256(trace code | product name | package)
fda188.split: first 8 hex digits of the order key: even is development, odd is untouched

route_c.response_checks: response model and provider must match the request and finish_reason must be stop; otherwise the case is failed
route_c.cost_source: usage.cost on the raw OpenRouter response; Inspect's ModelUsage.total_cost is computed from Inspect's own price table, so it is not used; a missing cost is unknown
route_c.reserve_note: Qwen 3.5 was removed from the route C reserve because it drafts untouched truth (decision A).
route_c.sealed_reservation: RunBudget holds back 200 calls at the $0.05 ceiling ($10) from development calls

ground_truth.development_off_taiwan_drafting: Pass 1 of the 20 Taiwan development truths was drafted by Claude (the assistant); Claude Opus route C results on development data carry that caveat.

untouched_truth_drafting.pass_1: drafted by a non-Claude model that is not a route C model under test: Qwen 3.5 VL through OpenRouter, slug and endpoint recorded on the run day
untouched_truth_drafting.pass_2: the owner verifies every value against the image and corrects it
untouched_truth_drafting.evidence_label: model-drafted, owner-verified (weaker than independent human transcription)
untouched_truth_drafting.egress: public corpus images only, sent to OpenRouter with the route C provider block (one endpoint, ZDR, data collection denied, no fallbacks); runs in a later phase under the spend stops
